# Earlier independent review disposition

Before the final evidence amendment, the same authorized reviewer independently
inspected the original specification, inputs, amendments, runner/controller,
all `run-003` provenance/JUnit/inspection/teardown artifacts and earlier logs.
This file summarizes that earlier report; the final report is retained separately
in `independent-review.md`.

The reviewer confirmed two actual 54-case successes for the synthesized root
recipe and matching tracked source, interpreter, local editable import, Git/tag
context and distribution version. They rejected experiment acceptance under the
frozen `run-003` protocol: interface names did not establish flags or route
absence. The observations could not retroactively establish a corrected network
predicate. Both assigned results remain no-go.

The reviewer also identified that at least 34 cases plus all top-level names
could accept omitted parameter cases; exact case multisets were required.
Interpreter binary hash, package version and Git describe were captured but
not enforced. Swap/tmpfs properties and final overall elapsed budget were not
fully enforced. These concerns motivated stricter acceptance in a separately
frozen replay, with raw pre-import/after-test link flags and all-table IPv4/IPv6
routes, rejection controls and new image/input hashes.

Their required network predicate was empty Docker networks, no administratively
UP non-loopback interfaces and no non-loopback routes, covering all relevant
routing tables. They required fail-closed parsing before the first upstream
provenance import and afterward, with retained Docker inspections and zero test
traffic as a separate supporting measurement. The final amendment implements
these requirements. Original CI/wheel provenance, public qualification,
cross-platform results and benefit remained unestablished in both assessments.
